name: Rimmon
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Ishbosheth had two captains of bands, Baanah and Rechab, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite of the children of Benjamin, for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin; and the Beerothites had fled to Gittaim.

The sons of Rimmon came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who lay on a bed at noon in the hottest part of the day, and came into the midst of the house as though they would fetch wheat, and smote him under the fifth rib.
